chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九

units.chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
units.title: 投充兵卒总纲：以世身为主、财福为凭；投兵须把世爻详，逢旺逢生去必昌，若遇旬空无对敌，如逢月破丧他乡；凡占投充兵者世以为用，得日辰生世或世旺相则功成利厚力加体康，若值旬空则无人对敌，若逢月破则大有刑伤大不吉利

rule.yi: 投军当兵，以世爻、身爻为主，以财爻、子孙（福）为凭据。投兵必须细看世爻：逢旺、逢生，去了必定兴旺；如果遇到旬空，就没有对手可打；如果逢月破，就死在他乡。凡是占投充当兵的，以世爻为用，只要得到日辰生世、或者世旺相，就功成利厚、力量增加、身体康健；如果值旬空，就没有人对敌；如果逢月破，就大有刑伤，非常不吉利。
rule.en: In enlisting as a soldier, take the Self and the Body as the chief and Wealth and Output as the ground. In joining the army one must examine the Self line in detail: if it meets thriving or generation, going will surely bring prosperity; if it meets the ten-day Void, there is no enemy to face; if it meets Month-break, one dies in a foreign land. In every divination about enlisting as a soldier, the Self is the Subject: if the Day generates the Self or the Self is thriving, one's service is accomplished, the profit is great, one's strength increases and one's body is hale; if it falls on the ten-day Void there is no one to oppose; if it meets Month-break there is much punishment and injury and it is greatly inauspicious.

zh: 以世身为主，财福为凭。
yi: 以世爻、身爻为主要看的，以财爻、子孙（福）为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Body as the chief to be looked at, and Wealth and Output as the ground.

zh: 投兵须把世爻详，逢旺逢生去必昌，
若遇旬空无对敌，如逢月破丧他乡。
yi: 投军必须细看世爻：逢旺、逢生，去了必定兴旺；
如果遇到旬空，就没有对手可打；如果逢月破，就死在他乡。
en: In joining the army one must examine the Self line in detail: if it meets thriving or generation, going will surely bring prosperity;
if it meets the ten-day Void, there is no enemy to face; if it meets Month-break, one dies in a foreign land.

zh: 凡占投充兵者，世以为用，但得日辰生世或世旺相，则功成利厚力加体康，若德旬空，则无人对敌。
若逢月破，则大有刑伤，大不吉利。
yi: 凡是占投充当兵的，以世爻为用，只要得到日辰生世、或者世旺相，就功成利厚、力量增加、身体康健；如果值旬空，就没有人对敌。
如果逢月破，就大有刑伤，非常不吉利。
en: In every divination about enlisting as a soldier, the Self is the Subject: if the Day generates the Self or the Self is thriving, one's service is accomplished, the profit is great, one's strength increases and one's body is hale; if it falls on the ten-day Void there is no one to oppose.
If it meets Month-break there is much punishment and injury and it is greatly inauspicious.

note.yi: 「投充」是应募、投身，「投充兵」就是投军当兵。「世身」是世爻和卦身。「德旬空」的「德」疑是「值」，译作「值旬空」。「旬空无对敌」是没有对手可以交战，书里没有说这是好是坏，这里只照字面译。「丧他乡」是死在外乡。这是书中事业各章的最后一章。
note.en: 'Touchong' is volunteering and committing oneself, and 'touchong bing' is joining the army as a soldier. 'Shishen' is the Self line and the Body of the hexagram. The 'de' of 'de xunkong' is presumably 'zhi', to fall on, and it is translated 'falls on the ten-day Void'. 'Xunkong wu duidi' is having no opponent to fight; the book does not say whether this is good or bad and it is translated literally. 'Sang taxiang' is dying in a foreign land. This is the last of the book's chapters on a career.

units.chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
units.title: 投充兵卒：随官入墓身遭厄、助鬼伤身命受殃；随军出战所忌者官也，临世临身临命而入墓者名曰随鬼入墓必有丧亡之凶难，鬼宜安静若逢财动能助鬼兴又伤身世者名曰助鬼伤身决主身陷命倾难归乡井

rule.yi: 世爻随着官爻入墓，身遭厄难；助官鬼伤身，性命受殃。随军出战，所忌的是官爻。如果官爻临在世爻、身爻、命爻上而入墓，叫做随鬼入墓，必定有丧亡的凶难；官鬼适宜安静，如果遇到财爻发动、能帮助官鬼兴旺，又伤克身爻、世爻，叫做助鬼伤身，一定主身陷险地、性命倾覆，难以回到家乡。
rule.en: If the Self follows the star of office into the tomb, one's person meets disaster; if one helps Pressure to injure the Body, one's life suffers calamity. In going out to battle with the army, what is feared is the star of office. If it rests on the Self, the Body or the fate line and enters the tomb, it is called following Pressure into the tomb, and there will surely be the misfortune of death; Pressure is best quiet, and if Wealth moves and can help Pressure to flourish, and also injures the Body or the Self, it is called helping Pressure to injure the Body, and it surely means that one's person falls into danger, one's life is overturned, and it is hard to return to one's native village.

zh: 随官入墓身遭厄，助鬼伤身命受殃。
yi: 世爻随着官爻入墓，身遭厄难；助官鬼伤身，性命受殃。
en: If the Self follows the star of office into the tomb, one's person meets disaster; if one helps Pressure to injure the Body, one's life suffers calamity.

zh: 随军出战，所忌者官也。
若临世临身临命而入墓者，名曰随鬼入墓，必有丧亡之凶难。
鬼宜安静，若逢财动能助鬼兴，又伤身世者，名曰助鬼伤身，决主身陷命倾，难归乡井。
yi: 随军出战，所忌的是官爻。
如果官爻临在世爻、身爻、命爻上而入墓，叫做随鬼入墓，必定有丧亡的凶难。
官鬼适宜安静；如果遇到财爻发动、能帮助官鬼兴旺，又伤克身爻、世爻，叫做助鬼伤身，一定主身陷险地、性命倾覆，难以回到家乡。
en: In going out to battle with the army, what is feared is the star of office.
If it rests on the Self, the Body or the fate line and enters the tomb, it is called following Pressure into the tomb, and there will surely be the misfortune of death.

Pressure is best quiet, and if Wealth moves and can help Pressure to flourish, and also injures the Body or the Self, it is called helping Pressure to injure the Body, and it surely means that one's person falls into danger, one's life is overturned, and it is hard to return to one's native village.

note.yi: 「随官入墓」「助鬼伤身」增删卜易对它们另有说法（ZS.06）：古人当作凶，作者说世旺的反而升官；那是问升选，这里是随军出战，问的事不同，取法也不同，这里一律以官鬼为大忌。「临命」的「命」按文意是本命。「乡井」是家乡。
note.en: 'Following the star of office into the tomb' and 'helping Pressure to injure the Body' have another account in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.06): the ancients took them as ominous, and the author said that a thriving Self on the contrary rises; that was asking about promotion and selection, while here it is going out to battle with the army, so the matter asked differs and so does the method, and here Pressure is throughout the great taboo. The 'fate' of 'lin ming' is by the sense the native fate. 'Xiangjing' is one's native place.

units.chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
units.title: 投充兵卒：官鬼若还冲克世不如不去反为良；军旅之忌惟以官鬼，若来冲世不过被彼克伐未决输赢，若来克世大有刑伤乃未沾利禄先遭戕戮，不如安分且守故乡

rule.yi: 官鬼如果冲克世爻，不如不去，反而是好。军旅的忌讳，只在官鬼：它来冲世，不过是被对方克伐，还没有决出输赢；它如果来克世，大有刑伤，就是还没有沾到利禄，就先遭杀戮；不如安守本分，暂且守着故乡。
rule.en: If Pressure clashes with or controls the Self, it is better not to go, which is on the contrary good. The taboo of the army is nothing but Pressure: if it comes to clash with the Self, one is merely attacked by the other side and victory or defeat is not yet decided; if it comes to control the Self, there is much punishment and injury, and before one has shared in any pay or rank one is struck down; it is better to keep to one's lot and hold one's native place for now.

zh: 官鬼若还冲克世，曾如不去反为良。
yi: 官鬼如果冲克世爻，不如不去，反而是好。
en: If Pressure clashes with or controls the Self, it is better not to go, which is on the contrary good.

zh: 军旅之忌，惟以官鬼，若来冲世，不过被彼克伐，未决输赢。
若来克世，大有刑伤，乃未沾利禄，选遭戕戮。
不如安分，且守故乡。
yi: 军旅的忌讳，只在官鬼；它来冲世，不过是被对方克伐，还没有决出输赢。
它如果来克世，大有刑伤，就是还没有沾到利禄，就先遭杀戮。
不如安守本分，暂且守着故乡。
en: The taboo of the army is nothing but Pressure: if it comes to clash with the Self, one is merely attacked by the other side and victory or defeat is not yet decided.
If it comes to control the Self, there is much punishment and injury, and before one has shared in any pay or rank one is struck down.
It is better to keep to one's lot and hold one's native place for now.

note.yi: 诀里「曾如不去反为良」的「曾如」按文意是「不如」，译作「不如不去」。「选遭戕戮」的「选」疑是「先」，译作「先遭杀戮」。这一条与前面一条（EL.125）取同一个关系：官鬼是随军出战的大忌。
note.en: The 'zeng ru' of 'zeng ru bu qu fan wei liang' in the verse is by the sense 'bu ru', better not, and it is translated 'it is better not to go'. The 'xuan' of 'xuan zao qianglu' is presumably 'xian', first, and it is translated 'before one has shared in any pay or rank one is struck down'. This entry takes the same relation as the previous one (EL.125): Pressure is the great taboo of going out to battle with the army.

units.chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
units.title: 投充兵卒：土官克世遭坑陷、金鬼冲身刀箭伤、水鬼定然逢波险、火官必主犯红光、木爻值鬼多刑责，福德交重最吉祥；克世之官大凶之象须分五属可以拒避，子孙为和解之神须得一发则万祸自消

rule.yi: 土属的官克世，遭坑陷；金属的官鬼冲身，被刀箭所伤；水属的官鬼，一定遇到风波险阻；火属的官，必主触犯火光；木爻值官鬼，多有刑责；福德（子孙）发动，最吉祥。克世的官是大凶之象，必须分它属于五行中的哪一类，才可以躲避：官鬼属土，要防对方挖陷坑，又要防疾病；金属的官鬼，忌讳锋利的刀箭，也防跌扑；水属的官鬼，必然设下背水的计谋，又被风波险阻；火属的官鬼，只要逃火患，又要顾虑营屯被烧的劫难；木属的官鬼，会有鞭打杖责之刑。子孙是和解之神，只要发动一次，万般祸患自然消散。
rule.en: If an Earth star of office controls the Self, one falls into a pit-trap; if a Metal Pressure clashes with the Body, one is hurt by knife and arrow; if a Water Pressure, one will surely meet the danger of waves; if a Fire star of office, one will surely run into the red glare; if a Wood line holds Pressure, there are many beatings and punishments; Output, the fortune virtue, moving is most auspicious. The star of office that controls the Self is an image of great ill, and one must tell which of the five kinds it belongs to in order to ward it off: if Pressure is of Earth, guard against the other side digging a trap-pit for one to fall into, and against illness; a Metal Pressure fears sharp blades and arrows, and one must guard against falls; a Water Pressure surely sets a back-to-the-river stratagem, and one is also blocked by wind and waves; with a Fire Pressure one need only flee the danger of fire and also fear the calamity of the camp being burned; a Wood Pressure brings the punishment of whip and cane. Output is the spirit of reconciliation, and if it moves even once, ten thousand calamities melt away of themselves.

zh: 土官克世遭坑陷，金鬼冲身刀箭伤，
水鬼定然逢波险，火官必主犯红光，
木爻值鬼多刑责，福德交重最吉祥。
yi: 土属的官克世，遭坑陷；金属的官鬼冲身，被刀箭所伤；
水属的官鬼，一定遇到风波险阻；火属的官，必主触犯火光；
木爻值官鬼，多有刑责；福德发动，最吉祥。
en: If an Earth star of office controls the Self, one falls into a pit-trap; if a Metal Pressure clashes with the Body, one is hurt by knife and arrow;
if a Water Pressure, one will surely meet the danger of waves; if a Fire star of office, one will surely run into the red glare;
if a Wood line holds Pressure, there are many beatings and punishments; Output, the fortune virtue, moving is most auspicious.

zh: 克世之官，大凶之象，须分五属可以拒避，如鬼属土，防彼掘陷坑入，又防疾病。
金鬼忌伊利锋刀箭，及防跌蹼。
水鬼必设背水之略，又被风波险阻。
火鬼唯逃火患，又虑烧屯之劫。
木鬼是有鞭朴之刑。
子孙为和解之神，须得一发，则万祸自消矣！
yi: 克世的官是大凶之象，必须分它属于五行中的哪一类，才可以躲避：官鬼属土，要防对方挖陷坑，又要防疾病。
金属的官鬼，忌讳锋利的刀箭，也要防跌扑。
水属的官鬼，必然设下背水的计谋，又被风波险阻。
火属的官鬼，只要逃火患，又要顾虑营屯被烧的劫难。
木属的官鬼，会有鞭打杖责之刑。
子孙是和解之神，只要发动一次，万般祸患自然消散！
en: The star of office that controls the Self is an image of great ill, and one must tell which of the five kinds it belongs to in order to ward it off: if Pressure is of Earth, guard against the other side digging a trap-pit for one to fall into, and against illness.
A Metal Pressure fears sharp blades and arrows, and one must guard against falls.
A Water Pressure surely sets a back-to-the-river stratagem, and one is also blocked by wind and waves.
With a Fire Pressure one need only flee the danger of fire and also fear the calamity of the camp being burned.
A Wood Pressure brings the punishment of whip and cane.
Output is the spirit of reconciliation, and if it moves even once, ten thousand calamities melt away of themselves!

note.yi: 「五属」是官鬼所属的五行。「坑陷」是陷阱。「红光」是火光，指火灾。「背水之略」是背水结阵、没有退路的战法，用的是韩信背水一战的典故。「烧屯」是烧营寨、屯粮之所。「鞭朴」是鞭打杖责。这一条与易隐征战占「五行」一组（YY.63 起：木为舟楫、火营寨、土炮石、金刀刃、水水泉）取同一类五行取象，但这里是按官鬼所属的五行看灾：土陷坑、金刀箭、水波险、火火患、木鞭朴。「和解之神」是能化解凶的神，即子孙（福神）。
note.en: 'Five kinds' are the five elements to which Pressure belongs. 'Kengxian' is a pit-trap. 'Hongguang' is the red glare, meaning fire. 'Beishui zhi lüe' is the stratagem of drawing up with the back to the water with no way to retreat, and alludes to Han Xin's battle with his back to the river. 'Shaotun' is burning the camp and the place where grain is stored. 'Bianpu' is the whip and cane. This entry takes the same kind of five-element images as the 'five elements' group of the Yi Yin war divination (from YY.63: Wood is boats, Fire is the camp, Earth is catapult stones, Metal is blades, Water is water and springs), but here the disaster is read by the element of Pressure: Earth the pit, Metal blade and arrow, Water the danger of waves, Fire the fire, Wood the whip and cane. 'The spirit of reconciliation' is the spirit that can dissolve ill, that is Output (the fortune spirit).

units.chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
units.title: 投充兵卒：世去克他宜出战、应来克我莫登场；世为我应为彼，若世克应爻则战必胜彼，应若克世彼必多能

rule.yi: 世爻去克对方，适宜出战；应爻来克我，不要登场。世爻是我，应爻是对方：如果世克应爻，打仗必定胜过对方；应如果克世，对方一定很有本事。
rule.en: If the Self goes to control the other, it is fitting to go out and fight; if the Other comes to control me, do not enter the field. The Self is me and the Other is the enemy: if the Self controls the Other line, one will surely beat the other in battle; if the Other controls the Self, he is surely very able.

zh: 世去克他宜出战，应来克我莫登场。
yi: 世爻去克对方，适宜出战；应爻来克我，不要登场。
en: If the Self goes to control the other, it is fitting to go out and fight; if the Other comes to control me, do not enter the field.

zh: 世为我，应为彼，若世克应爻，则战必胜彼。
应若克世，彼必多能。
yi: 世爻是我，应爻是对方；如果世克应爻，就一定战胜对方。
应爻如果克世，对方一定很有本事。
en: The Self is me and the Other is the enemy: if the Self controls the Other line, one will surely beat the other in battle.
If the Other controls the Self, he is surely very able.

note.yi: 这一条和前面的「官鬼是随军出战的大忌」是两层：官鬼看自己会不会遭难，世应看这一仗能不能胜。与出师征伐章（EL.12 起）、易隐征战占「世克应可战、应克世宜守防贼」（YY.54）和本书前面「世克应则大胜，应克世则难赢」（EL.64）取同一个关系。
note.en: This entry and the earlier 'Pressure is the great taboo of going out to battle' are two layers: Pressure shows whether one will meet disaster, and the Self and the Other show whether this battle can be won. It takes the same relation as the chapter on sending out troops (from EL.12), 'if the Self controls the Other one can fight, if the Other controls the Self defend and guard against bandits' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.54), and 'if the Self controls the Other it is a great victory, if the Other controls the Self it is hard to win' earlier in this book (EL.64).

units.chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
units.title: 投充兵卒：财旺饷资加倍得、兄兴诚恐灭兵粮；财乃口粮旺相则丰余休囚则不敷，兄为耗祟安静则可发动则有扣除之患

rule.yi: 财旺相，饷银资助成倍得到；兄爻兴旺，实在怕兵粮被灭掉。财是口粮，旺相就丰足有余，休囚就不够；兄是耗损的祸祟，安静就可以，发动就有被克扣的忧患。
rule.en: If Wealth is thriving, pay and supplies are gained doubled; if Peer flourishes, one truly fears the soldier's rations being wiped out. Wealth is the ration, which when thriving is abundant and when resting or imprisoned is not enough; Peer is the baleful drain, and if quiet it is tolerable, and if it moves there is the trouble of deductions.

zh: 财旺饷资加倍得，兄兴诚恐灭兵粮。
yi: 财旺相，饷银资助成倍得到；兄爻兴旺，实在怕兵粮被灭掉。
en: If Wealth is thriving, pay and supplies are gained doubled; if Peer flourishes, one truly fears the soldier's rations being wiped out.

zh: 财乃口粮，旺相则丰余，休囚则不敷，兄为耗祟，安静则可。
发动，则有扣除之患。
yi: 财是口粮，旺相就丰足有余，休囚就不够；兄是耗损的祸祟，安静就可以。
发动，就有被克扣的忧患。
en: Wealth is the ration, which when thriving is abundant and when resting or imprisoned is not enough; Peer is the baleful drain, and if quiet it is tolerable.
If it moves, there is the trouble of deductions.

note.yi: 「饷」是军饷，「口粮」是口粮、兵粮。「耗祟」是耗损钱粮的祸祟。「扣除」是克扣。这一条与易隐征战占「财旺相粮草丰足……内兄动克财」（YY.59）、黄金策征战「财为粮草之本根，兄乃伏兵之形势」（HJC.88）取同一类象：财是粮饷，兄劫财。
note.en: 'Xiang' is military pay, and 'kouliang' is rations and soldiers' grain. 'Haosui' is the baleful drain that wastes money and grain. 'Kouchu' is deducting and skimming. This entry takes the same kind of image as 'Wealth thriving, provisions are abundant ... the inner Peer moves to control Wealth' in the Yi Yin war divination (YY.59) and 'Wealth is the root of provisions and Peer is the shape of an ambush' in the Huangjin Ce on campaigns (HJC.88): Wealth is pay and grain, and Peer robs Wealth.

units.chapter: 投充兵卒章第一百三十九
units.title: 投充兵卒：官爻持世无冲克必作先锋佐帝皇；官爻最宜持世又宜安静旺相则有奇能美爵，若值冲克必有奸佞窃夺功权之祸

rule.yi: 官爻持世、没有冲克，必定做先锋，辅佐帝王。官爻最适宜持世，又适宜安静旺相，这样就有奇特的才能和美好的爵位；如果遇到冲克，必有奸佞之人窃夺功劳权柄的祸患。
rule.en: If the Pressure line holds the Self with no clash or control, one will surely be a vanguard and assist the sovereign. The Pressure line is best holding the Self, and also best quiet and thriving, and then one has rare ability and a fine rank; if it meets clash or control, there will surely be the misfortune of treacherous men stealing one's merit and power.

zh: 官爻持世无冲克，必作先锋佐帝皇。
yi: 官爻持世、没有冲克，必定做先锋，辅佐帝王。
en: If the Pressure line holds the Self with no clash or control, one will surely be a vanguard and assist the sovereign.

zh: 官爻最宜持世，又宜安静旺相，则有奇能美爵。
若值冲克，必有奸佞窃夺功权之祸。
yi: 官爻最适宜持世，又适宜安静旺相，就有奇特的才能和美好的爵位。
如果遇到冲克，必有奸佞窃夺功劳权柄的祸患。
en: The Pressure line is best holding the Self, and also best quiet and thriving, and then one has rare ability and a fine rank.
If it meets clash or control, there will surely be the misfortune of treacherous men stealing one's merit and power.

note.yi: 这一条说官爻持世是吉：投军这件事里，官鬼既是随军出战的大忌（EL.125、EL.126），又是持世作先锋、有爵位的吉象。两处不冲突：忌的是官鬼冲克世、随官入墓、助鬼伤身，喜的是官爻持世、安静旺相、不受冲克。这是投充兵卒一章的收尾。
note.en: This entry says that the Pressure line holding the Self is auspicious: in joining the army, Pressure is both the great taboo of going out to battle (EL.125, EL.126) and the auspicious image of holding the Self as a vanguard and winning rank. The two do not clash: what is feared is Pressure clashing with or controlling the Self, following the star of office into the tomb, and helping Pressure to injure the Body; what is welcomed is the Pressure line holding the Self, quiet and thriving, and not clashed or controlled. This closes the chapter on enlisting as a soldier.
